name: Balanced adder tree (reassociation)
template: Rebalance a left-associated addition chain into a balanced tree so the carry/addition depth is log2(N) instead of N. Pure reassociation of the same operands; no new registers.

example.after: wire [W-1:0] s0 = a + b; wire [W-1:0] s1 = c + d; assign y = s0 + s1;

guardrails: Do not add or remove registers; latency must be unchanged.
Do not change operand bit-widths or the module ports.
Reassociate only; do not drop, reorder-with-sign-change, or introduce new operands.
